Kirk flagged #705 TurnStateChangedEvent: turn-state/economy/menu are RULEBOOK concepts (rulebooks/dnd5e/character) genericized into the agnostic encounter/events spine — mislayers + discards the type. Same on EconomyConsumed (#698). SURFACED reshape analysis to director, did NOT implement. CRUX evidence: encounter pkg is dnd5e-coupled TODAY (11 source files import rulebooks/dnd5e); only encounter/events sub-pkg is agnostic; broker codec type-switches on events.* concretes. Fully-agnostic encounter is a SEPARATE goal (my prompt). So flattening rulebook types into events to keep events agnostic while the rest of encounter is coupled = inconsistent half-measure. MY READ: option (a) carry the rulebook type directly via a generic typed-payload envelope (event = {kind, actorID, payload json.RawMessage}; dnd5e marshals ActorTurnState in, host routes by kind) — keeps the spine's transport agnostic without genericizing/discarding the rulebook type; also fixes EconomyConsumed consistently. Option (b) dnd5e-layer emits its own event = cleaner long-term but needs a rulebook→broker publish seam that doesn't exist (broker is encounter-pkg, sealed events interface). AWAITING director+Kirk direction before building. If durable → north-star rule.

#704 (TakeAction wave): encounter pushes TurnStateChangedEvent on turn-state/economy mutation — PR #705 OPEN, CI green, Copilot reviewed clean (no comments), merge-ready. Closes the Inv-12 push-refresh gap surfaced by the api lane.
items.details: Filed issue #704 (board #13, Wave=TakeAction set via GraphQL). New events.TurnStateChangedEvent on the encounter spine: rulebook-AGNOSTIC (flattened TurnStateSnapshot = economy ints + []MenuEntry of ref/name/economy_slot/target_kind/available/reason strings; spine imports no rulebook types, like EconomyConsumed). Embeds eventMeta (game-time + correlation id). Registered in broker codec. Encounter.publishTurnStateChanged builds snapshot from ActorTurnState via buildTurnStateSnapshot; audience = actor's controlling player (private menu); no-op for NPC/stat-snapshot seats. Emitted on EVERY turn-state mutation: turn start (AFTER TurnStartedEvent so cause precedes refresh — refactored seedActorTurn to mutate-only, publish at the 2 call sites SetMode+EndTurn) + every action (non-attack via takeCharacterAction, attack via applyAndPublishOutcome). Post-action push shares causing action's corr id (Inv 8); turn-start carries none. publishAttackOutcome + publishActionResolved now RETURN the corr id they stamped so the push reuses it (NPC path discards it). rpg-api projects to proto TurnStateChanged (envelope field 45). CONTRACT for api lane: TurnStateChangedEvent{actor_id, state:TurnStateSnapshot, per_player}; TurnStateSnapshot{in_combat, turn_number, actions/bonus/reactions/movement_remaining, menu:[]MenuEntry}; MenuEntry{ref,name,economy_slot,target_kind,available,reason} + spine occurred_at/correlation_id. Real-path tests: push on non-attack, attack (Monk bonus strike in pushed menu), turn-start (TurnStarted precedes in seq); snapshot reflects post-action economy + pre-empts unaffordable action. Done-gate verified on PR HEAD: build+vet clean, uncached go test -race ./... all green, lint clean (only goconst-on-test noise CI excludes). ADR-0033 + encounter.md + status.md. Follow-up under #54: movement-step economy deltas (Beat 2) reuse this event. AWAITING director merge.

Attack path publishes it with PLACEHOLDERS: attackActionRef='dnd5e:action:attack' (combat.go:65), attackEconomyConsumed()={Actions:1} (combat.go:72). Beat-1 generalizes these to the actor's real submitted ref + real consumption. (2) Canonical menu world = character pkg: TWO types — AvailableAbility{Ref,Name,ActionType(action/bonus/reaction),CanUse,Reason,ResourceCurrent,ResourceMax} for action-economy spenders (combat abilities + features), AvailableAction{Ref,Name,CanUse,Reason} for granted-capacity consumers (strikes+move). NEITHER carries target_kind today. Entrypoints: char.ActivateAbility (combat ability/feature, validates+deducts action economy, rolls back on fail) and char.ExecuteAction (granted-capacity strike/move, decrements granted). Both return updated Abilities+Actions. StartTurn seeds economy {1 action,1 bonus,1 reaction, Speed movement, empty Granted}. (3) TWO REF NAMESPACES (contract-critical): dnd5e:combat_abilities:{attack,dash,dodge,disengage,help,hide,ready,off_hand_attack} (spend action economy, GRANT capacity/condition) vs dnd5e:actions:{move,strike,off_hand_strike,flurry_strike,unarmed_strike} (CONSUME granted capacity, the 'doing'). The design doc's flat {type:'action',id:'attack'/'dodge'} and the #698 placeholder 'dnd5e:action:attack' (singular) match NEITHER. MUST resolve: does the wire carry the toolkit's native two-namespace refs verbatim, or a flattened action-menu ref? My read: carry native refs verbatim (no flattening = no translation rules in api). (4) Proto today: AvailableAction{ref,display_name,available,unavailable_reason} (NO target_kind/economy_slot); ActionEconomy{actions/bonus/reactions/movement_remaining, capacities map<string,int32>}; TurnState{initiative_order,active_entity_id,round,economy,available_actions}; EncounterEvent envelope {sequence(1),timestamp(2)} has NO correlation_id and NO ActionResolved oneof variant (highest oneof field=61). (5) ActivateFeature (encounter/activate_feature.go) is the EXACT template for the unified TakeAction: loads char via LoadFromData(ctx,&charData,e.bus), calls ActivateAbility, captures condition events, diffs resources pre/post, publishes broker events, returns updated charData JSON. (6) UNIFICATION SUBTLETY: Monk bonus strike has TWO impls — character.GrantedMartialArtsBonus+executeUnarmedStrike (capacity decrement) AND actions.MartialArtsBonusStrike (action obj publishing FlurryStrikeRequestedTopic, self-consumes bonus action). Must pick which the encounter path drives. checkPostStrikeGrants() grants GrantedMartialArtsBonus after a monk main-hand strike when a bonus remains.

items.summary: #697 VERIFIED: the ActionResolved→AttackResolved→DamageDealt triple is ALREADY emitted correctly by #698 for the attack path, incl. miss
items.details: publishAttackOutcome (combat.go:323-382, shipped in #698) ALREADY emits all three correlated events: ActionResolvedEvent (umbrella + economy_consumed), AttackResolvedEvent ALWAYS (line 360, OUTSIDE the if outcome.Hit block → fires on a MISS too — #594 is structurally already fixed at the toolkit layer for the attack path), DamageDealtEvent only on hit. All share corrID=corr-<encID>-<seq> (correlationFor, line 389) via publishCorrelated (line 396, broker stamps game-time). So Beat-1's REMAINING event work is NOT plumbing — it's: (1) replace attackActionRef placeholder with the actor's REAL submitted ref; (2) replace attackEconomyConsumed()={Actions:1} with the REAL pre/post economy diff; (3) make NON-ATTACK actions (Dodge) emit their OWN ActionResolvedEvent — today they emit NOTHING because the whole path is gated at combat_phased.go:65 ref.ID!=attack, so Dodge never reaches any publish. The #594 surfacing for misses is ALREADY done for attacks in the toolkit; what remains for #594 end-to-end is api un-suppressing + the proto variant existing (D9). NOTE: comment at combat.go:303 says 'AttackResolvedEvent (attack roll detail, always)' confirming always-emit.

items.summary: #697 KEY ARCH FINDING: held *character.Character is the unification path, no re-load needed
items.details: VERIFIED hydration.go: the encounter's LoadFromData cascade ALREADY hydrates *character.Character onto e.bus via hydratePlayer (line 113 character.LoadFromData) and stores it in e.combatants[entityID] (line 65), typed as combat.Combatant. hydration.go:229 + cleanupHydrated already type-assert it back to *character.Character. THIS is the canonical menu/economy owner, already loaded + conditions Applied (the #689 single-subscribe point). => Beat-1 TakeAction should TYPE-ASSERT the held combatant to *character.Character and drive StartTurn/AvailableActions/AvailableAbilities/ActivateAbility/ExecuteAction on the ALREADY-HELD instance — NOT re-load from CharDataJSON like ActivateFeature does. ActivateFeature's fresh LoadFromData (activate_feature.go:100) predates/sidesteps the #689 cascade and is now arguably a redundant double-load smell — NOTE as adjacent finding, do NOT fix this wave (checkpoint-over-rabbit-hole). GAP CONFIRMED: character.StartTurn (seeds economy 1/1/1+Speed) is NEVER called by the encounter path — encounter emits TurnStartedEvent (combat.go:145,220) but never seeds the held char's economy. THAT is why rpg-api hacks ActionEconomyData{1,1,1,Movement:30} (the Invariant-2 leak the wave doc names at activate_feature.go:~50-112). Beat-1 moves seeding INTO encounter turn-start: call char.StartTurn on the held character when a player's turn begins (SetMode TurnBased first actor + EndTurn→next actor). Today TakeActionPhased reads FLAT snapshot stats off PlayerData (AttackBonus/DamageDice/DamageType) and never touches the char economy — that's the attack-only shortcut Beat-1 replaces.

items.summary: #697 chunk 2 (menu/economy unification) — design + CONTRACT, NOT yet started as of 2026-06-01
items.details: Canonical world = character pkg two-level economy (ActionEconomyData + granted-capacity + buildAvailableAbilities/buildAvailableActions). Encounter verb path (TakeAction) must load the character (same LoadFromData cascade ActivateFeature uses; char already on e.bus) and consult AvailableAbilities()+AvailableActions() for the menu, and validate+deduct via ActivateAbility/ExecuteAction. CONTRACT to settle for protos: (1) AvailableAction menu item shape {ref:string, display_name:string, available:bool, unavailable_reason:string, economy_slot enum, target_kind enum}; (2) target_kind enum = {SELF, SINGLE_ENTITY, POSITION, AREA} toolkit-authored; (3) economy_slot enum = {ACTION, BONUS_ACTION, REACTION, MOVEMENT, FREE} mapping coreCombat.ActionType + granted-capacity; (4) EconomyConsumed moves from Actions:1 placeholder to real consumption sourced from the char economy pre/post diff. Existing infra: Dodge/Dash/Disengage combat abilities + Attack exist and Activate; Help/Hide have refs (refs.CombatAbilities.Help/Hide) but NO constructors — must implement. Monk Martial Arts bonus strike: actions.MartialArtsBonusStrike exists (bonus-action, publishes FlurryStrikeRequestedTopic, self-removes); checkPostStrikeGrants() already grants GrantedMartialArtsBonus after a monk main-hand strike when a bonus action remains. Generalize applyAndPublishOutcome to carry the actor's submitted ref instead of attackActionRef const.
